Drone that hit Auvere power station identified as Ukrainian by Estonia

25 March 2026 · Auvere power station

Reported foreign

On the morning of 25 March 2026 a military drone hit a chimney of the Auvere power station in Ida-Viru County, Estonia. The drone had entered Estonia from Russia.

Estonian authorities said the drone was Ukrainian. Its intended target was reported to be in Russia, not Estonia. The incident was treated as spillover from the war, and an intentional attack on Estonia has not been established.

No injuries were reported, and there were no reports of any interruption to the plant’s operations. Authorities examined the impact site and the wreckage. A stray drone was also reported in Latvia the same day, and the Baltic defence ministers issued a joint statement on the drone incidents.
